name: Builds Package Version
description: A workflow run produced this package version. The corpus edge whose ABSENCE is the finding: a registry version with no run behind it is how five incidents read. DERIVED from a tag naming convention (`sha-<short sha>` on the image matching the run's head commit), never reported by GitHub, so `match_kind` says how and `attested` stays null until an attestation surface reads it.

match_kind.description: `tag_sha`: a container tag of the form `sha-<short>` (or a full sha) matches the run's `head_sha`. The only derivation implemented; a version tagged any other way carries no edge, which the article names as a limit rather than a finding.

attested.description: Whether a build attestation vouches for this run producing this version. Three states: null means no attestation surface has been read — never `false`, which would be a claim.
